items.title: DeepSeek推出Super-agent架構！打造24小時自主AI代理、跨平台並行處理多項任務
paras: 中國人工智慧（AI）新創公司DeepSeek持續探索AI代理（Agent）的應用邊界，DeepSeek Harness團隊週六（31日）發布技術文章，提出名為「超級代理」（Super-agent）的新型代理系統架構，試圖突破現有AI助手受限於單一對話工作階段的瓶頸，讓AI能夠長時間在線、跨平台接收指令，並行處理多項複雜任務，甚至在使用者下達指令前主動辨識問題、推進工作。
DeepSeek指出，隨著模型能力提升，個人助理逐漸成為新的應用方向，但目前主流代理仍以單一工作階段為基本工作單位，不同工作階段之間彼此獨立，難以支援多任務及團隊協作需求。
在這種模式下，單一任務的執行能力取決於模型，多項任務的處理上限卻受到使用者注意力限制。
DeepSeek提出的Super-agent，則透過雙層架構、事件驅動、異步多通道互動、存算分離及外部監控機制，將繁瑣的會話管理與上下文同步交由系統處理，讓使用者能從個別執行細節轉向更高層次的決策與成果驗收。

DeepSeek Super-agent採雙層架構　單任務執行時間縮短近半

DeepSeek表示，Super-agent的核心設計是雙層架構，分為Router與Worker兩個層級。
Router負責接收使用者指令、判斷任務性質及分配工作，同時統整不同管道傳來的資訊，維持整體任務脈絡；Worker則負責執行具體工作，各自處理獨立任務，完成後再向Router回報結果。
這種設計讓不同Worker能夠平行工作，避免彼此干擾，也讓Router統一管理跨Session的上下文資訊。
例如，使用者先在即時通訊軟體（IM）中要求採用方案A，之後又在GitHub Pull Request（PR）留言改採方案B，系統仍能辨識兩項指令屬於同一專案，並據此調整執行方向，不必要求使用者重新交代先前討論內容。
DeepSeek也公布實驗比較結果。在純單一工作階段模式下，任務完成時間的第95百分位數（p95）為29.5分鐘；採用Super-agent雙層架構後，則降至15.7分鐘，縮短近半。
在功能設計上，DeepSeek將Super-agent歸納為四項特徵：

連續性： 使用者可透過IM、GitHub留言等既有工作介面與同一代理互動，不必管理不同工作階段的上下文。
效率： 能夠快速回應，並行處理多項複雜任務，不必等待前一項工作完成才能接收新指令。
主動性： 持續觀察外部環境事件，主動辨識值得處理的事項，不再完全依賴使用者逐一派發任務。
持久性： 長時間保持在線，接入使用者實際工作環境，遇到異常時也能透過系統機制恢復。


事件驅動讓AI主動處理問題　兩階段過濾降低無效運算

除了雙層架構，事件驅動也是Super-agent的重要設計。傳統AI助手通常必須等候使用者輸入指令才會開始工作，Super-agent則能持續監控IM群組、GitHub及持續整合（CI）系統等工作環境，接收其中發生的事件，並判斷是否需要採取行動。
DeepSeek將這些外部訊息稱為Trigger。不過，工作環境中存在大量無關資訊，如果每則訊息都交由大型語言模型（LLM）判斷，不僅增加運算成本，也可能影響系統效率。
為此，DeepSeek設計兩階段過濾機制。第一階段是程序層策略（Fast Path），透過程式碼依據訊息來源、群組範圍，以及使用者或機器人白名單等條件進行篩選，將不相關事件直接排除。
第二階段則是語意層策略（Slow Path），將通過第一階段的候選事件交由LLM分析，根據提示詞設定的規則及上下文，判斷是否值得採取行動。
這讓系統不必對所有外部訊息都啟動完整的模型推理流程，也能透過提示詞調整判斷規則。
此外，DeepSeek還引入投機執行的概念，讓代理在正式收到明確任務前，就能根據已出現的事件預先展開工作。
例如，當群組中有人提到某項程式錯誤可能相當嚴重，代理便可先在背景嘗試重現問題、尋找修復方式，讓後續工作更有效率。

存算分離搭配Watchdog　讓AI持續在線並自動監控任務

為了讓Super-agent長時間運作，DeepSeek也採用存算分離設計，將運算與狀態管理拆開。
其中，代理的運算程序部署在雲端伺服器，能夠持續在線；會話狀態則儲存在資料庫中，即使伺服器重新啟動，也不會因程序中斷而遺失。
另一方面，使用者本機的程式碼儲存庫、工具鏈及私人資料不必全部搬到雲端。雲端代理可透過輕量級Daemon程序遠端呼叫本機環境，讓運算與資料存取分別在不同環境中進行。
長時間運作也帶來另一項挑戰，就是代理可能陷入無限循環、任務停滯，或逐漸偏離原定目標。
DeepSeek因此加入外部Watchdog監控機制，負責觀察其他Worker的執行狀態，辨識是否出現異常或偏離方向，必要時介入處理，以提升長時間任務的可靠性。
DeepSeek強調，這套架構並非建立在全新的計算機理論之上，而是將傳統計算機系統中的工程設計應用於代理，包括雙層架構、事件驅動、存算分離及Watchdog等概念。

內部Super-agent已投入使用　大規模部署仍有待驗證

DeepSeek表示，目前基於這套設計思路及DeepSeek Harness打造的內部Super-agent，已經持續運作，日常工作包括重現與修復問題、回應程式碼審查，以及協助DeepSeek Harness本身持續更新。
不過，這套架構仍有多項問題有待解決。DeepSeek在文章中也指出，長期記憶如何管理、多個代理如何協作，以及安全與隱私如何保障，都是後續需要持續探索的方向。
此外，文章展示的實驗數據仍來自合成負載，測試規模為300則訊息及20項工作請求，與真實大型團隊的複雜工作環境仍有差距。當系統擴大至更多使用者與任務時，Router是否可能成為效能瓶頸，以及不同Worker之間如何協調任務衝突，都還需要進一步驗證。
DeepSeek認為，隨著模型能力提升，代理系統的主要瓶頸正逐漸從模型本身轉向底層架構。Super-agent希望讓AI從被動等待指令的對話工具，進一步演進為能夠持續在線、主動處理工作，並融入個人及團隊工作流程的自主協作者。
未來，模型能力與系統架構若能同步進步，這種工作模式有望成為人機協作的新常態。

items.title: 盼追加預算11月順利過關 卓揆：讓普發1萬最快春節前發錢 行政準備絕不拖延
items.title_en: Hoping for a Smooth Passage of the Additional Budget in November, Premier Zhuo: Distribute NT$10,000 to All Before the Lunar New Year, Administrative Preparations Won't Delay
paras: 行政院長卓榮泰昨（31）日出席活動指出，在全體國人打拚下，台灣今年第3季經濟成長率概估達14.36%，全年預估可達11.06%，在國際貨幣組織最新報告中高居世界第2。隨著經濟體質奠定穩健基礎，立法院本周已將明（2027）年度中央政府總預算案付委審查，下周二他將赴立法院進行115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案專案報告，期盼6076億元的追加預算案能在11月順利通過，發揮穩定民生效果，行政準備絕不拖延，讓AI紅利全民共享普發一萬，最快農曆春節前就能發錢。
卓榮泰強調，現在是中華民國台灣史上最好的時代，人民勤奮、高科技與中小微企業全力發展、百工百業智慧運用，每位國人都獲得更全面、完整的照顧。他指出，「台灣愈被需要，台灣就愈重要」，全世界也會將台灣安全視作全球問題。因此政府將持續與友盟國家合作，維持印太地區和平穩定，並提升國防實力，讓台灣成為可靠、可信賴、可以合作的夥伴。
針對追加預算案的執行進度，卓榮泰表示，追加預算案若能在11月順利通過，後續僅剩1個月時間可以執行。不過行政院一定會做好所有行政準備工作，只要預算一通過就會馬上執行，絕不拖延國家整體向前進步的腳步。除了第3季GDP表現亮眼外，去年台灣經濟成長率也高達8.76%，瑞士洛桑管理學院公布今年世界競爭力排名，台灣整體競爭力更名列全球第4。
在財政與政策規劃方面，明年度中央政府總預算案歲出編列3兆9266億元。政府在嚴守財政紀律、不額外舉債、不排擠重要建設優先順序的前提下，編列了AI紅利全民共享普發現金1萬元相關預算。若總預算案順利於明年1月5日前三讀通過，並於1月20日前由總統公布，預計最快可在農曆春節前啟動發放作業，讓全民共享經濟成果。
卓榮泰進一步說明，政府施政持續從加薪、減稅、增福利、多照顧等4個面向著手。從出生時的生育補助、0至2歲公托與準公托補助、2至6歲育兒津貼，到2至18歲每月5000元成長津貼、大學每年35000元私立大學學雜費補助，再到出社會後的減負擔措施與65歲以上的長照3.0，政府希望在財政更加健全的基礎上，為每一個階段的國人提供無縫接軌的全齡照顧。
產業發展部分，政府除了全面推動AI新十大建設與13項戰略產業外，也特別提出8年1000億元的《中小微企業轉型升級發展條例》草案。一年投入約125億元，加上既有公務預算，每年約有250億元全力協助中小微企業升級。政府期盼讓中小微企業成為高科技產業供應鏈的一環，具備向全世界發展的能力，進而促進百工百業智慧運用，最終達到全民智慧生活圈的目標。
paras_en: Premier Zhuo Rongtai attended an event yesterday (the 31st) and noted that with the effort of all citizens, Taiwan's estimated Q3 2024 economic growth rate reached 14.36%, with a full‑year forecast of 11.06%, ranking second in the world in the latest IMF report. With a solid economic foundation, the Legislative Yuan this week sent the 2027 central government’s total budget to the committee for review, and next Tuesday he will report the special 115th‑year central government additional budget to the Yuan, hoping the NT$607.6 billion supplement can pass in November, stabilize livelihoods, and that administrative preparations will not be delayed, allowing the AI dividend of NT$10,000 per person to be distributed as early as before the Lunar New Year.

Zhuo emphasized that this is the best era in the history of the Republic of China (Taiwan), with diligent people, high‑tech and SMEs fully developing, and all industries smartly applied, giving every citizen more comprehensive care. He said, “The more Taiwan is needed, the more important it becomes,” and that the world will view Taiwan’s security as a global issue. Hence the government will continue cooperating with allied nations to maintain peace and stability in the Indo‑Pacific and boost defence capabilities, making Taiwan a reliable, trustworthy partner.

Regarding the implementation timeline of the additional budget, Zhuo said that if it passes in November there will be only one month left for execution. Nevertheless, the Executive Yuan will complete all administrative preparations, and once the budget is approved it will be implemented immediately, without slowing the nation’s progress. In addition to the strong Q3 GDP performance, Taiwan’s growth last year hit 8.76%, and the Lausanne Institute of Business Administration ranked Taiwan fourth globally in competitiveness this year.

In fiscal and policy planning, the next year’s central government total budget is set at NT$3.9266 trillion. While strictly observing fiscal discipline, avoiding extra borrowing and not crowding out priority projects, the budget includes funds for the NT$10,000 AI dividend for all citizens. If the total budget passes its third reading by Jan 5 2025 and is promulgated by the President by Jan 20, distribution could start before the Lunar New Year, allowing everyone to share the economic gains.

Zhuo further explained that government policies continue to focus on four pillars: higher wages, tax cuts, increased welfare, and greater care. From birth subsidies, public childcare for ages 0‑2, preschool subsidies, child allowances for ages 2‑6, monthly NT$5,000 growth allowances for ages 2‑18, NT$35,000 annual private‑university tuition subsidies, to post‑employment relief measures and Long‑Term Care 3.0 for those over 65, the government aims, on a sound fiscal base, to provide seamless, age‑spanning support for all citizens.

In industry development, the government is pushing ten new AI infrastructure projects and 13 strategic industries, and has also proposed an eight‑year, NT$100 billion “SME Transformation and Upgrade Development Act” draft. About NT$12.5 billion will be invested annually, plus existing public funds, totaling roughly NT$25 billion each year to help SMEs upgrade. The goal is to integrate SMEs into high‑tech supply chains, give them global development capacity, promote smart use across all sectors, and ultimately achieve a nationwide smart‑living ecosystem.

items.title: 國1五堵至汐止段不再「打結」！卓揆：基北往返尖峰省15分鐘 車速升至80公里
items.title_en: National Highway 1 Wudu to Xizhi Section No Longer "Bottlenecked"! Premier Chou: Peak‑hour Travel Between Keelung and Taipei Cut by 15 Minutes, Speeds Up to 80 km/h
paras: 國道1號五堵交流道至汐止交流道路段拓寬工程正緊鑼密鼓推進，行政院長卓榮泰昨(31)日前視察時強調，該工程以路拓寬、增匝道、結打開為核心，完工後將有效改善車流交織問題，尖峰時段車速可大幅提升至 80公里，讓基隆往返台北尖峰行車時間縮短10至15分鐘，實現一小時內往返目標為首都圈黃金廊帶打造順暢的高速公路路廊。
卓榮泰指出，基隆與台北距離並不遙遠，但跨縣市交通經常打結，造成通勤族極大困擾。行政院於2024年就任不久後即核定國道1號五堵至汐止段拓寬工程建設計畫，由中央攜手地方共同處理解決台北、新北與基隆間的交通瓶頸，避免單一縣市孤掌難鳴。
工程計畫主要聚焦於主線雙向由2車道拓寬為3車道，並新增匝道引導車輛提前分流，同時將地磅站匯出入匝道調整為平行式匝道。完工後尖峰時段平均車速可從每小時23至32公里大幅提升至80至82公里，大幅縮短通勤距離，實現台北與基隆1小時內往返的交通願景。
除了國道拓寬，政府同步關注大眾運輸量能提升。基隆捷運正加速規劃中，客運方面則針對基隆市區與七堵之間的安樂區滿載問題進行協調優化，由在地民意代表與業者溝通分流發車，同時中央也研議補助電動巴士以補足運能，致力讓基隆鄉親減少通勤折騰。
卓榮泰提到，基隆作為台灣重要港口，納入首都圈黃金廊帶後，除了維繫傳統文化，更期待引進科技產業推動產業升級，並透過都市更新、危老重建及威海營區舊址BOT案注入民間活力。這些區域發展計畫都需要中央與地方緊密合作才能順利推動。
針對國道1號五堵至汐止拓寬工程第1次招標未果，卓榮泰特別勉勵交通部高速公路局團隊持續努力，並鼓勵優良廠商踴躍參與投標。期許在中央、地方與在地民意代表共同攜手下，讓關鍵工程儘速動工，為首都圈民眾提供更優質便捷的交通服務。
paras_en: The widening project for the segment of National Highway 1 between the Wudu interchange and the Xizhi interchange is progressing rapidly. During a site visit yesterday (the 31st), Premier Chou Rong‑tai emphasized that the project focuses on road widening, adding ramps, and opening up the previously tangled junction. Once completed, it will effectively alleviate traffic weaving, allowing peak‑hour speeds to rise dramatically to 80 km/h and reducing the Keelung‑Taipei commute by 10‑15 minutes, achieving the goal of a sub‑one‑hour round‑trip and creating a smooth highway corridor in the capital‑region golden belt.

Premier Chou noted that the distance between Keelung and Taipei is not far, yet cross‑city traffic often gets tangled, causing great inconvenience for commuters. Shortly after taking office in 2024, the Executive Yuan approved the widening plan for the Wudu‑to‑Xizhi section of Highway 1, a joint effort by the central and local governments to resolve the traffic bottleneck among Taipei, New Taipei and Keelung, preventing any single jurisdiction from being left to struggle alone.

The plan mainly expands the mainline from two lanes per direction to three lanes, adds new ramps to divert traffic earlier, and reconfigures the weigh‑station entry‑exit ramps into parallel ramps. After completion, average peak‑hour speeds are expected to jump from 23‑32 km/h to 80‑82 km/h, dramatically shortening commuting time and realizing the vision of a sub‑one‑hour round‑trip between Taipei and Keelung.

In addition to the highway widening, the government is simultaneously focusing on boosting public‑transport capacity. The Keelung MRT is being fast‑tracked, while bus services are being coordinated to address overcrowding on routes between downtown Keelung and Qidu’s Anle area. Local representatives and operators are working together to stagger departures, and the central government is studying subsidies for electric buses to augment capacity, aiming to ease commuters’ burdens.

Premier Chou said that, as a key Taiwanese port, Keelung’s inclusion in the capital‑region golden belt not only preserves its traditional culture but also aims to attract high‑tech industries for industrial upgrading. Urban renewal, reconstruction of aging infrastructure, and a BOT project on the former Wei‑hai military camp all seek to inject private‑sector vitality. These development plans require close cooperation between central and local authorities to move forward smoothly.

Regarding the first tender for the Wudu‑to‑Xizhi Highway 1 widening that did not yield a winner, Premier Chou specifically encouraged the Highway Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation to keep pushing forward and urged qualified firms to actively submit bids. He expressed hope that, with the combined efforts of central and local governments and local representatives, the critical project can break ground soon and provide the capital‑region public with higher‑quality, more convenient transportation services.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉融資恐殺出引爆補跌壓力 台股走勢可能有2種情境
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Wind Vane: Margin Buying Threatens to Trigger Sell‑off Pressure, Two Possible Scenarios for Market Trend
paras: 美股半導體上周五慘遭血洗，不僅費半指數崩跌超過7%，台積電ADR也重挫近6%，創8月以來新低，11月台股開局瀰漫肅殺氣氛，台股交易員認為，補跌態勢難逃，跌破半年線位置後就看融資殺出的壓力何時止住，長線投資者等待籌碼沉澱。
台股上周跌829點，周線連3黑，10月以來跌掉2728點，光輝10月成黯淡10月，台股交易員不諱言，本周市場將遭受籌碼凌亂殺出的巨大壓力，但此為整體市場的系統性議題，個股即便繳出漂亮的財報數據，恐怕也難以己身之力力挽狂瀾，先求相對持穩。
外資上周呈現連5賣，投信則是連3買，顯示內資仍是積極逢低加碼；其中，外資單周賣1734億元，自台積電提走625億元，並賣超聯發科365億元，台達電284億元，元大台灣50達236億元，日月光投控174億元，聯電和南亞均超過130億元，臻鼎-KY、國巨*和欣興均逾100億元。
永豐投顧分析，與7月不同的是，這次融資沒有降，統計2003年以來25個指數跌超過10%的波段，大盤跌約10%後融資才開始減少、跌15%以上容易出現恐慌賣出，整段融資減幅約為指數跌幅的1.23倍，且融資的高低點都落後指數，低點中位數落後11個交易日。
觀察這次指數自高點回檔約7%，融資餘額由10月12日的6533億元高點到10月29日只降到6339億元，不能完全期待用「殺融資」來確認落底，但融資的餘額減少同樣可以做為市場籌碼浮額風向球。
進入11月後，永豐投顧認為，半年線附近位置45000點是這一波的多空分水嶺，以目前的籌碼推估兩種情境，(1)盤整守住44600點以上，融資隨盤整緩降、降幅在10%以內，等於不殺融資，(2)若跌破半年線一路下探年線，大盤跌幅將達20%，融資要砍到約4200億元才會止穩。
不過，永豐投顧也提到，目前加權指數的預估本益比由6月高點約21倍，一路降到16倍出頭，已貼近16倍是近一年最低，長線布局的報酬空間變大。
paras_en: U.S. semiconductor stocks were brutally slashed last Friday, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index plunging more than 7% and TSMC ADR tumbling nearly 6% to an August low. The ominous atmosphere carried over into the opening of the November Taiwan market, and traders believe a corrective rally is inevitable. Once the index falls below its six‑month moving average, the focus will shift to when the pressure from margin‑buying sell‑offs eases, while long‑term investors wait for capital to settle.

The Taiwan market dropped 829 points last week, marking three consecutive weekly declines and a total loss of 2,728 points since October. The once‑bright October has turned bleak, and traders admit that this week the market will face intense pressure from chaotic capital outflows. Even stocks that posted impressive earnings may struggle to reverse the tide on their own, so the priority is to maintain relative stability.

Foreign investors sold for the fifth consecutive week last week, while domestic institutional investors bought for the third straight week, showing that local capital remains active in buying on dips. Foreign investors sold NT$173.4 billion in total, including NT$62.5 billion of TSMC shares, NT$36.5 billion of MediaTek, NT$28.4 billion of Delta Electronics, NT$23.6 billion of Yuanta Taiwan 50 ETF, NT$17.4 billion of ASE Technology Holding, and over NT$13 billion each of UMC and Nan Ya Plastics, as well as more than NT$10 billion each of Zhen Ding‑KY, Yageo and Unimicron.

According to Yongfeng Investment Advisory, unlike July, margin buying this time has not declined. Looking at the 25 index declines of over 10% since 2003, margin balances only began to fall after the market dropped about 10%; a decline of more than 15% often triggers panic selling. The total reduction in margin balances is roughly 1.23 times the index’s drop, and both the peaks and troughs of margin lag the index, with troughs lagging by a median of 11 trading days.

Observing that the index has retraced about 7% from its recent high, margin balances fell from a peak of NT$653.3 billion on October 12 to NT$633.9 billion on October 29. While we cannot rely solely on a “margin kill” to confirm a bottom, the shrinking margin balance still serves as a useful gauge of market‑wide capital flow.

Entering November, Yongfeng sees the 45,000‑point level near the six‑month moving average as the watershed between bulls and bears. Based on current capital conditions, they outline two scenarios: (1) if the market consolidates above 44,600 points, margin balances will ease gradually with a decline of less than 10%, meaning no aggressive margin liquidation; (2) if the index breaks below the six‑month line and heads toward the yearly average, the market could fall up to 20%, and margin balances would need to be cut to around NT$420 billion before stabilizing.

Yongfeng also notes that the weighted index’s forward P/E ratio has fallen from a June high of about 21× to just over 16×, near a one‑year low. This lower valuation expands the potential return space for long‑term investors.

items.title: 卡尼拒急簽美國貿易協議！稱不惜等川普下台：不符合加拿大利益就不簽
items.title_en: Carney Refuses to Rush Signing US Trade Deal, Says He’ll Wait Until Trump Leaves Office: Won’t Sign If It Doesn’t Serve Canada’s Interests
paras: 加拿大總理卡尼（Mark Carney）表示，若美國提出的貿易協議條件不符合加拿大利益，他不會急於簽署，並暗示即使美國期中選舉結束，加拿大仍可能持續成為美國總統川普的施壓目標。
根據《彭博》報導，卡尼接受《Politico》專訪時表示，即使這意味著必須等到白宮迎來下一任總統，他也不會簽署自己認為條件不利的協議。
卡尼說：「我們與美國確實有達成協議的空間，而且可以很快完成。但如果協議不符合加拿大利益，我們不會只是為了達成協議而勉強簽署。」
當被問及這是否代表他願意等到下一屆美國政府上台時，卡尼回答：「如果有必要，那麼是的。」
卡尼另接受蒙特婁《La Presse》專訪時暗示，他不認為美國週二（3日）舉行的期中選舉結果，會讓川普在貿易政策上的立場出現重大轉變。
他說：「本屆政府與任何國家達成的協議，都沒有不包含關稅的。這就是現實。問題在於，關稅稅率會有多高。」
民調顯示，民主黨可能重新掌握美國眾議院，但參議院由哪個政黨取得多數席次，仍遠未明朗。目前密西根州、緬因州及阿拉斯加州等地的選情都相當膠著。
美加關稅爭端已成為部分美國邊境州的選舉議題，甚至促使川普同意調整部分針對加拿大商品的關稅，以協助緬因州共和黨籍聯邦參議員柯林斯（Susan Collins）爭取連任。柯林斯已在參議院任職近30年，目前正面臨激烈選戰。
卡尼接受上述兩家媒體訪問之際，加拿大政府正於蒙特婁與歐洲官員舉行峰會。
加拿大近來持續深化與其他國家的關係，並試圖分散貿易夥伴，以降低對美國市場的依賴。
在此次峰會上，卡尼與歐盟執委會主席馮德萊恩（Ursula von der Leyen）進一步推動建立所謂的「未來聯盟」，合作範圍包括整合供應鏈、協調經濟安全政策、國防合作，以及投資關鍵原物料。
在各國紛紛致力於增強烏克蘭抵禦攻擊的能力之際，卡尼稱川普對俄政策「毫無助益」。卡尼告訴《Politico》，他要向俄羅斯總統普丁傳達的訊息是，加拿大將進一步收緊制裁。他說：「離開烏克蘭，停止你的戰爭罪行。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said that if the terms of a US‑proposed trade agreement do not serve Canada’s interests, he will not rush to sign it, and hinted that even after the US midterm elections, Canada could remain a pressure point for President Trump.
According to Bloomberg, Carney told Politico in an interview that even if it means waiting for the next president in the White House, he will not sign an agreement he believes is disadvantageous.

Carney said, “We do have room to reach an agreement with the United States, and it could be done quickly. But if the deal does not align with Canada’s interests, we will not force a signature just to get a deal.”
When asked whether this meant he was willing to wait for the next US administration, Carney replied, “If it’s necessary, then yes.”
Carney also told Montreal’s La Presse that he does not think the outcome of Tuesday’s (the 3rd) US midterm election will cause a major shift in Trump’s trade policy stance.
He added, “Any agreement this administration reaches with any country will involve tariffs. That’s the reality. The question is how high those tariff rates will be.”
Polls show Democrats may retake the US House of Representatives, but it remains unclear which party will control the Senate. Races in Michigan, Maine and Alaska are especially tight.

The US‑Canada tariff dispute has become a campaign issue in several US border states, even prompting Trump to agree to adjust some tariffs on Canadian goods to help Republican Senator Susan Collins of Maine in her re‑election bid. Collins, who has served in the Senate for nearly 30 years, is now facing a fierce contest.
While Carney was speaking to the two media outlets, the Canadian government was holding a summit in Montreal with European officials.
Canada has been deepening ties with other nations and trying to diversify its trade partners to reduce reliance on the US market.

At the summit, Carney and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen advanced plans for a so‑called “Future Alliance,” covering supply‑chain integration, coordination of economic‑security policies, defence cooperation, and investment in critical raw materials.

As countries work to bolster Ukraine’s ability to resist attacks, Carney said Trump’s policy toward Russia is “of no help.” He told Politico that the message he wants to send to Russian President Vladimir Putin is that Canada will tighten sanctions further. He said, “Leave Ukraine, stop your war crimes.”

items.title: 幣安將於週日分階段恢復提款服務！已補回遭駭客竊走63億美元中的60億美元
items.title_en: Binance to Resume Withdrawals in Stages on Sunday, Replenishing $6 billion of the $6.3 billion Lost to Hack
paras: 全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）表示，將於週日分階段恢復提款服務。在遭駭客攻擊、導致平台價值63億美元的資產遭竊後，公司已動用自有資金買回替代代幣，目前已補足其中60億美元的損失。美國官員指出，這起攻擊是由北韓政府支持、名為 TraderTraitor 的駭客組織所發動。
根據《彭博》報導，幣安於亞洲時間週五（30日）上午暫停交易。幣安在 X 平台發布聲明表示，第一階段提款服務將於新加坡時間下午2時至5時開始恢復。
幣安表示：「我們將分階段恢復提款服務，並根據過去一週的用戶需求數據，優先安排不同代幣，以確保各個區塊鏈網路與資產交易組合都能謹慎恢復。每項服務在重新開放前，都必須完成穩定性與安全性檢查。」
根據《路透》報導，幣安週六（31日）在社群平台 X 發文表示：「我們已經補足此次駭客攻擊所造成損失中的60億美元。」此前，幣安曾表示已補足遭竊資金的90%。
幣安指出，目前剩餘未補足的金額已低於10%，主要由流動性較低的資產組成，因此可能需要更長時間，才能籌措到所需數量。
FBI 同日發布聲明，將此次攻擊歸咎於北韓政府支持的駭客組織 TraderTraitor。調查人員觀察到，該組織成員正將竊取的資產兌換成以太幣（Ethereum），FBI 預期，相關資產接下來還會透過相關技術進一步洗錢。
多年來，北韓一直否認利用與政府有關的網路部隊從事間諜活動、金融竊盜及創造收入。北韓駐日內瓦代表團及駐中國大使館均未回應置評請求。
分析人士此前已將這起攻擊事件指向北韓，並指出，這可能是史上規模最大的金融竊盜案。
幣安一直與業界合作夥伴合作，試圖凍結部分受影響資產，截至週五（30日）已找到約30億美元。公司也一再強調，將自行承擔此次駭客攻擊造成的資金損失。
幣安在 X 上表示，用於重新買回代幣的資金，來自公司10億美元的用戶安全資產基金（Secure Asset Fund for Users，SAFU）中的部分資金、部分期貨保險基金，以及公司自身的企業資金庫。SAFU 是幣安持有的比特幣儲備，目的是在發生安全漏洞時保障客戶資產。
幣安共同執行長何一週六表示，公司將動用SAFU基金50%的資金。幣安則承諾，將補回基金資金，使其規模恢復至約10億美元。
幣安另指出，公司已在內部預留約63.4億美元資金，用於承擔此次攻擊造成的損失。
駭客攻擊事件發生後，加密貨幣價格週五下跌，幣安則試圖向客戶保證，其資金仍受到保障。
共同執行長Richard Teng先前表示，這起資安漏洞涉及一場「複雜的攻擊」，攻擊者入侵一台筆記型電腦，並使用專門設計來刪除自身活動證據的惡意軟體，使事件更難追蹤及調查。
攻擊事件發生後，幣安暫停用戶提款，但公司週六表示，仍按原定計畫，預計於週日（11月1日）重新開放提款功能。
此外，幣安也表示，已針對10月31日格林威治時間午夜時平台持有的資產重新進行快照，作為其儲備證明程序的一部分。
幣安指出，持有以下10種代幣的用戶，包括比特幣（BTC）、以太幣（ETH）、泰達幣（USDT）、幣安幣（BNB）、Solana（SOL）、USD Coin（USDC）、瑞波幣（XRP）、USD1、RLUSD及Zcash（ZEC），待完整儲備證明公布後，將能驗證平台對其資產的儲備支持比例至少達到1比1。
paras_en: The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange Binance said it will resume withdrawal services in stages on Sunday. After a hack that stole $6.3 billion of assets from the platform, the company used its own funds to buy back replacement tokens and has now covered $6 billion of the loss. U.S. officials said the attack was carried out by a hacker group called TraderTraitor backed by the North Korean government.
According to Bloomberg, Binance halted trading on Friday (the 30th) morning Asian time. In a post on X, Binance said the first stage of withdrawals will resume from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m Singapore time.

Binance said, “We will resume withdrawals in stages and, based on user demand data from the past week, prioritize different tokens to ensure that each blockchain network and asset‑trading portfolio can be restored cautiously. Every service must pass stability and security checks before it is reopened.”

Reuters reported that on Saturday (the 31st) Binance posted on X, “We have now replenished $6 billion of the loss caused by the recent hack.” Previously Binance had said it had covered 90% of the stolen funds.
Binance noted that the remaining unrecovered amount is now below 10%, consisting mainly of low‑liquidity assets, so it may take longer to raise the needed funds.

The FBI issued a statement the same day attributing the attack to the North Korean‑backed hacker group TraderTraitor. Investigators observed the group’s members converting the stolen assets into Ethereum, and the FBI expects the assets will be further laundered using related techniques.

For years North Korea has denied that its government‑linked cyber units engage in espionage, financial theft, or revenue‑generating activities. North Korea’s Geneva delegation and its embassy in China did not respond to comment requests.
Analysts have previously pointed to North Korea as the source of the attack, noting it could be the largest financial theft in history.

Binance has been working with industry partners to freeze portions of the affected assets and, as of Friday (the 30th), has located about $3 billion. The company repeatedly emphasizes that it will bear the financial loss from the hack itself.

In a post on X, Binance said the funds used to repurchase tokens came from part of its $1 billion Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), portions of its futures insurance fund, and the company’s own corporate treasury. SAFU is Binance’s Bitcoin reserve intended to protect customer assets in the event of a security breach.
Co‑CEO He Yi said on Saturday that the company will use 50% of the SAFU fund. Binance also pledged to replenish the fund so that it returns to roughly $1 billion in size.
Binance added that it has set aside about $6.34 billion internally to cover the losses from this attack.
After the hack, cryptocurrency prices fell on Friday, and Binance tried to assure customers that their funds remain protected.

Co‑CEO Richard Teng previously said the security breach involved a “complex attack” in which the attacker compromised a laptop and used custom malware designed to erase evidence of their activity, making the incident harder to trace and investigate.
Following the attack, Binance halted user withdrawals, but on Saturday the company said it still plans to reopen the withdrawal function on Sunday, November 1, as originally scheduled.
Binance also said it has taken a new snapshot of the assets held on the platform at midnight GMT on October 31 as part of its reserve‑proof process.

Binance noted that users holding any of the following ten tokens—Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), Binance Coin (BNB), Solana (SOL), USD Coin (USDC), Ripple (XRP), USD1, RLUSD and Zcash (ZEC)—will be able to verify that the platform’s reserve support ratio for their assets is at least 1:1 once the full reserve proof is published.

items.title: AI不只要算力更拚交付速度！FII、FIT深化合作因應客戶「昨天到貨」急單需求
items.title_en: AI Needs Not Only Compute Power but Faster Delivery! FII and FIT Deepen Cooperation to Meet Customers' “Yesterday Delivery” Urgent Orders
paras: AI需求快速擴大，客戶對供應鏈的要求已不再只是產品效能與技術規格，更進一步延伸至供應規模及交付速度。鴻海(2317-TW)透過集團垂直整合優勢，結合工業富聯(FII)(601138-CN)的AI運算系統整合能力，以及旗下鴻騰精密科技(FIT)(6088-HK)的高速互聯與關鍵零組件技術，透過技術創新與協同合作，共同因應客戶對下一世代 AI 基礎設施的需求。
FII董事長鄭弘孟與FIT董事長盧松青於2026鴻海科技日對談時指出，AI發展已進入系統競爭的新階段。盧松青表示，過去客戶關心的是產品規格能不能做出來，如今則進一步要求能否做得更多、更快，甚至希望當天下午就能交貨。鄭弘孟也幽默回應，有些客戶甚至恨不得產品「昨天就能搭火箭送到」，凸顯AI需求快速攀升下，客戶對供應鏈反應速度及交付效率的要求日益提高。
從鴻海集團角度來看，AI伺服器並非單一產品的競爭，而是涵蓋運算系統、連接技術、電力管理與散熱等多個環節。FII聚焦AI運算系統與伺服器整合，FIT則從高速互聯及關鍵零組件切入，透過各自的技術專長，加上鴻海母集團跨領域資源與垂直整合能力，可望進一步強化產品開發與系統整合的協作效率，回應客戶對AI基礎設施快速擴建及交付的需求。

隨著AI伺服器運算規模擴大，系統內部資料傳輸、機櫃供電及散熱需求同步提高，相關零組件與技術也成為AI基礎建設不可或缺的一環。FIT目前布局高密度Midplane連接器及CHIPLINK 448G，支援伺服器內部大量資料高速傳輸；光通訊方面則涵蓋800G、1.6T及CPO技術，並發展ELSFP外置光源方案。在電力與散熱方面，則透過高功率供電方案、硬銅排，以及結合快速接頭、浮動式對接與防漏設計的液冷技術，協助AI資料中心提升供電及散熱效率。
除AI資料中心外，FIT也將連接與電力管理技術延伸至智慧移動領域，布局智慧電力骨幹、高壓連接器及電子化高壓安全技術，並透過精密加工能力支援高速連接器與光通訊產品發展，持續擴大在AI及智慧移動兩大應用市場的布局。
paras_en: AI demand is expanding rapidly, and customers’ supply‑chain requirements are no longer limited to product performance and technical specifications; they now extend to supply scale and delivery speed. Hon Hai (2317‑TW) leverages its group’s vertical integration advantage, combines Industrial Fulian (FII) (601138‑CN)’s AI computing system integration capability, and its subsidiary Hon Teng Precision Technology (FIT) (6088‑HK)’s high‑speed interconnect and key component technologies. Through technological innovation and collaborative cooperation, they jointly address customers’ needs for next‑generation AI infrastructure.

FII Chairman Zheng Hongmeng and FIT Chairman Lu Songqing noted during the 2026 Hon Hai Technology Day dialogue that AI development has entered a new stage of system competition. Lu said that in the past customers cared whether product specifications could be achieved; now they further demand more, faster, and even want same‑day afternoon delivery. Zheng humorously replied that some customers even wish the product could be “rocket‑shipped yesterday,” highlighting that as AI demand soars, customers’ expectations for supply‑chain responsiveness and delivery efficiency are increasingly high.

From Hon Hai Group’s perspective, AI servers are not a competition of a single product but encompass computing systems, connectivity technology, power management and cooling across multiple links. FII focuses on AI computing systems and server integration, while FIT approaches from high‑speed interconnects and key components. By combining their technical expertise with Hon Hai’s cross‑domain resources and vertical integration capability, they aim to further strengthen product development and system integration collaboration efficiency, meeting customers’ needs for rapid AI infrastructure expansion and delivery.

As AI server computing scales grow, internal data transmission, rack power supply and cooling demands rise in tandem, making related components and technologies indispensable to AI infrastructure. FIT is currently deploying high‑density midplane connectors and CHIPLINK 448G to support massive high‑speed data transfer within servers; in optical communications it covers 800G, 1.6T and CPO technologies, and is developing an ELSFP external light source solution. For power and cooling, it offers high‑power supply schemes, hard‑copper busbars, and liquid‑cooling technology that combines quick‑connect fittings, floating docking and leak‑proof designs to boost power and thermal efficiency in AI data centers.

Beyond AI data centers, FIT is extending its connectivity and power‑management technologies to the smart mobility sector, positioning smart power backbones, high‑voltage connectors and electronic high‑voltage safety technologies, and using its precision machining capabilities to support the development of high‑speed connectors and optical communication products, continuously expanding its footprint in both AI and smart mobility markets.

items.title: 中國戰略礦產儲量大增！錸資源暴增逾200%　黃金、鎳相當於新增數十座大型礦床
items.title_en: China's Strategic Mineral Reserves Surge! Lanthanum Resources Increase Over 200%, Gold and Nickel Equivalent to Dozens of New Large Mines
paras: 中國官方對全國礦產資源進行重新評估後發現，黃金、鎳及其他戰略性礦產的資源量大幅增加。
根據中國官媒《新華社》週六（31日）報導，中國自然資源部公布的數據顯示，此次評估發現，中國保有錸資源量增加超過200%。黃金資源量增加幅度相當於50座大型礦床，鎳則相當於30座大型礦床。
此外，鎵、銦、鉭及釩等礦產資源量也大幅增加，各自的增幅均相當於超過10座大型礦床。
此次評估歷時一年，針對17種戰略性礦產展開調查，範圍涵蓋中國1800多個在產礦山及大中型礦區。整項計畫動員超過100個機構、近2,000名調查人員，足跡遍及27個省、自治區及直轄市。
此次重新評估也將伴生礦產資源、低品位礦床，以及過去被認為難以開採的礦床納入計算，進一步擴大中國可利用戰略性礦產資源的估算規模。
另外，中國也在西北部新疆地區的拜城縣（Baicheng），發現首座古河流湖泊相砂鋯礦床，有望大幅增加中國國內鋯資源供應，並可能降低對進口鋯礦的依賴。
鋯礦是提煉金屬鋯的來源之一。鋯可用於核反應爐燃料棒包殼，以及航太產業使用的高溫合金；另一項此次資源量大幅增加的戰略金屬錸，則主要用於製造噴射發動機零組件所需的高溫超合金。
此次調查結果出爐之際，中國正尋求強化國內礦產資源基礎，以確保先進製造、航太及核能產業所需的礦物供應。
不過，這次公布的資源量增幅，反映的是全國性評估後修訂的資源估算結果，並不一定代表發現了新的礦床。
paras_en: After a nationwide reassessment of mineral resources, Chinese officials found that the reserves of gold, nickel and other strategic minerals have increased significantly.

According to a Saturday (31st) report by the state media Xinhua, data released by the Ministry of Natural Resources showed that the reassessment found China’s lanthanum reserves increased by more than 200%. The increase in gold reserves is equivalent to 50 large mines, while nickel is equivalent to 30 large mines.
In addition, the reserves of gallium, indium, tantalum and vanadium also increased significantly, each increase equivalent to more than 10 large mines.

The reassessment took one year, surveying 17 strategic minerals across more than 1,800 operating mines and large‑to‑medium mining areas in China. The project mobilized over 100 institutions and nearly 2,000 investigators, covering 27 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government.

The reassessment also incorporated associated mineral resources, low‑grade mines, and mines previously considered difficult to exploit, further expanding the estimated scale of China’s usable strategic mineral resources.

Additionally, China discovered its first ancient river lake sand zircon mine in Baicheng County, Xinjiang, which could significantly boost domestic zircon supply and reduce dependence on imported zircon.

Zircon ore is one source of zirconium metal, used for nuclear reactor fuel rod cladding and high‑temperature alloys in aerospace. Another strategic metal whose reserves increased dramatically, lanthanum, is mainly used to manufacture high‑temperature superalloys for jet engine components.

At the time the survey results were released, China was seeking to strengthen its domestic mineral resource base to ensure the supply of minerals needed for advanced manufacturing, aerospace and nuclear energy industries.
However, the announced increase in resource estimates reflects revised estimates after a nationwide assessment and does not necessarily indicate the discovery of new mines.

items.title: 盼追加預算11月順利過關 卓揆：讓普發1萬最快春節前發錢 行政準備絕不拖延
items.title_en: Hoping for a Smooth Passage of the Additional Budget in November, Premier Zhuo: Distribute NT$10,000 to All Before the Lunar New Year, Administrative Preparations Won't Delay
paras: 行政院長卓榮泰昨（31）日出席活動指出，在全體國人打拚下，台灣今年第3季經濟成長率概估達14.36%，全年預估可達11.06%，在國際貨幣組織最新報告中高居世界第2。隨著經濟體質奠定穩健基礎，立法院本周已將明（2027）年度中央政府總預算案付委審查，下周二他將赴立法院進行115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案專案報告，期盼6076億元的追加預算案能在11月順利通過，發揮穩定民生效果，行政準備絕不拖延，讓AI紅利全民共享普發一萬，最快農曆春節前就能發錢。
卓榮泰強調，現在是中華民國台灣史上最好的時代，人民勤奮、高科技與中小微企業全力發展、百工百業智慧運用，每位國人都獲得更全面、完整的照顧。他指出，「台灣愈被需要，台灣就愈重要」，全世界也會將台灣安全視作全球問題。因此政府將持續與友盟國家合作，維持印太地區和平穩定，並提升國防實力，讓台灣成為可靠、可信賴、可以合作的夥伴。
針對追加預算案的執行進度，卓榮泰表示，追加預算案若能在11月順利通過，後續僅剩1個月時間可以執行。不過行政院一定會做好所有行政準備工作，只要預算一通過就會馬上執行，絕不拖延國家整體向前進步的腳步。除了第3季GDP表現亮眼外，去年台灣經濟成長率也高達8.76%，瑞士洛桑管理學院公布今年世界競爭力排名，台灣整體競爭力更名列全球第4。
在財政與政策規劃方面，明年度中央政府總預算案歲出編列3兆9266億元。政府在嚴守財政紀律、不額外舉債、不排擠重要建設優先順序的前提下，編列了AI紅利全民共享普發現金1萬元相關預算。若總預算案順利於明年1月5日前三讀通過，並於1月20日前由總統公布，預計最快可在農曆春節前啟動發放作業，讓全民共享經濟成果。
卓榮泰進一步說明，政府施政持續從加薪、減稅、增福利、多照顧等4個面向著手。從出生時的生育補助、0至2歲公托與準公托補助、2至6歲育兒津貼，到2至18歲每月5000元成長津貼、大學每年35000元私立大學學雜費補助，再到出社會後的減負擔措施與65歲以上的長照3.0，政府希望在財政更加健全的基礎上，為每一個階段的國人提供無縫接軌的全齡照顧。
產業發展部分，政府除了全面推動AI新十大建設與13項戰略產業外，也特別提出8年1000億元的《中小微企業轉型升級發展條例》草案。一年投入約125億元，加上既有公務預算，每年約有250億元全力協助中小微企業升級。政府期盼讓中小微企業成為高科技產業供應鏈的一環，具備向全世界發展的能力，進而促進百工百業智慧運用，最終達到全民智慧生活圈的目標。
paras_en: Premier Zhuo Rongtai attended an event yesterday (the 31st) and noted that with the effort of all citizens, Taiwan's estimated Q3 2024 economic growth rate reached 14.36%, with a full‑year forecast of 11.06%, ranking second in the world in the latest IMF report. With a solid economic foundation, the Legislative Yuan this week sent the 2027 central government’s total budget to the committee for review, and next Tuesday he will report the special 115th‑year central government additional budget to the Yuan, hoping the NT$607.6 billion supplement can pass in November, stabilize livelihoods, and that administrative preparations will not be delayed, allowing the AI dividend of NT$10,000 per person to be distributed as early as before the Lunar New Year.

Zhuo emphasized that this is the best era in the history of the Republic of China (Taiwan), with diligent people, high‑tech and SMEs fully developing, and all industries smartly applied, giving every citizen more comprehensive care. He said, “The more Taiwan is needed, the more important it becomes,” and that the world will view Taiwan’s security as a global issue. Hence the government will continue cooperating with allied nations to maintain peace and stability in the Indo‑Pacific and boost defence capabilities, making Taiwan a reliable, trustworthy partner.

Regarding the implementation timeline of the additional budget, Zhuo said that if it passes in November there will be only one month left for execution. Nevertheless, the Executive Yuan will complete all administrative preparations, and once the budget is approved it will be implemented immediately, without slowing the nation’s progress. In addition to the strong Q3 GDP performance, Taiwan’s growth last year hit 8.76%, and the Lausanne Institute of Business Administration ranked Taiwan fourth globally in competitiveness this year.

In fiscal and policy planning, the next year’s central government total budget is set at NT$3.9266 trillion. While strictly observing fiscal discipline, avoiding extra borrowing and not crowding out priority projects, the budget includes funds for the NT$10,000 AI dividend for all citizens. If the total budget passes its third reading by Jan 5 2025 and is promulgated by the President by Jan 20, distribution could start before the Lunar New Year, allowing everyone to share the economic gains.

Zhuo further explained that government policies continue to focus on four pillars: higher wages, tax cuts, increased welfare, and greater care. From birth subsidies, public childcare for ages 0‑2, preschool subsidies, child allowances for ages 2‑6, monthly NT$5,000 growth allowances for ages 2‑18, NT$35,000 annual private‑university tuition subsidies, to post‑employment relief measures and Long‑Term Care 3.0 for those over 65, the government aims, on a sound fiscal base, to provide seamless, age‑spanning support for all citizens.

In industry development, the government is pushing ten new AI infrastructure projects and 13 strategic industries, and has also proposed an eight‑year, NT$100 billion “SME Transformation and Upgrade Development Act” draft. About NT$12.5 billion will be invested annually, plus existing public funds, totaling roughly NT$25 billion each year to help SMEs upgrade. The goal is to integrate SMEs into high‑tech supply chains, give them global development capacity, promote smart use across all sectors, and ultimately achieve a nationwide smart‑living ecosystem.

items.title: 國1五堵至汐止段不再「打結」！卓揆：基北往返尖峰省15分鐘 車速升至80公里
items.title_en: National Highway 1 Wudu to Xizhi Section No Longer "Bottlenecked"! Premier Chou: Peak‑hour Travel Between Keelung and Taipei Cut by 15 Minutes, Speeds Up to 80 km/h
paras: 國道1號五堵交流道至汐止交流道路段拓寬工程正緊鑼密鼓推進，行政院長卓榮泰昨(31)日前視察時強調，該工程以路拓寬、增匝道、結打開為核心，完工後將有效改善車流交織問題，尖峰時段車速可大幅提升至 80公里，讓基隆往返台北尖峰行車時間縮短10至15分鐘，實現一小時內往返目標為首都圈黃金廊帶打造順暢的高速公路路廊。
卓榮泰指出，基隆與台北距離並不遙遠，但跨縣市交通經常打結，造成通勤族極大困擾。行政院於2024年就任不久後即核定國道1號五堵至汐止段拓寬工程建設計畫，由中央攜手地方共同處理解決台北、新北與基隆間的交通瓶頸，避免單一縣市孤掌難鳴。
工程計畫主要聚焦於主線雙向由2車道拓寬為3車道，並新增匝道引導車輛提前分流，同時將地磅站匯出入匝道調整為平行式匝道。完工後尖峰時段平均車速可從每小時23至32公里大幅提升至80至82公里，大幅縮短通勤距離，實現台北與基隆1小時內往返的交通願景。
除了國道拓寬，政府同步關注大眾運輸量能提升。基隆捷運正加速規劃中，客運方面則針對基隆市區與七堵之間的安樂區滿載問題進行協調優化，由在地民意代表與業者溝通分流發車，同時中央也研議補助電動巴士以補足運能，致力讓基隆鄉親減少通勤折騰。
卓榮泰提到，基隆作為台灣重要港口，納入首都圈黃金廊帶後，除了維繫傳統文化，更期待引進科技產業推動產業升級，並透過都市更新、危老重建及威海營區舊址BOT案注入民間活力。這些區域發展計畫都需要中央與地方緊密合作才能順利推動。
針對國道1號五堵至汐止拓寬工程第1次招標未果，卓榮泰特別勉勵交通部高速公路局團隊持續努力，並鼓勵優良廠商踴躍參與投標。期許在中央、地方與在地民意代表共同攜手下，讓關鍵工程儘速動工，為首都圈民眾提供更優質便捷的交通服務。
paras_en: The widening project for the segment of National Highway 1 between the Wudu interchange and the Xizhi interchange is progressing rapidly. During a site visit yesterday (the 31st), Premier Chou Rong‑tai emphasized that the project focuses on road widening, adding ramps, and opening up the previously tangled junction. Once completed, it will effectively alleviate traffic weaving, allowing peak‑hour speeds to rise dramatically to 80 km/h and reducing the Keelung‑Taipei commute by 10‑15 minutes, achieving the goal of a sub‑one‑hour round‑trip and creating a smooth highway corridor in the capital‑region golden belt.

Premier Chou noted that the distance between Keelung and Taipei is not far, yet cross‑city traffic often gets tangled, causing great inconvenience for commuters. Shortly after taking office in 2024, the Executive Yuan approved the widening plan for the Wudu‑to‑Xizhi section of Highway 1, a joint effort by the central and local governments to resolve the traffic bottleneck among Taipei, New Taipei and Keelung, preventing any single jurisdiction from being left to struggle alone.

The plan mainly expands the mainline from two lanes per direction to three lanes, adds new ramps to divert traffic earlier, and reconfigures the weigh‑station entry‑exit ramps into parallel ramps. After completion, average peak‑hour speeds are expected to jump from 23‑32 km/h to 80‑82 km/h, dramatically shortening commuting time and realizing the vision of a sub‑one‑hour round‑trip between Taipei and Keelung.

In addition to the highway widening, the government is simultaneously focusing on boosting public‑transport capacity. The Keelung MRT is being fast‑tracked, while bus services are being coordinated to address overcrowding on routes between downtown Keelung and Qidu’s Anle area. Local representatives and operators are working together to stagger departures, and the central government is studying subsidies for electric buses to augment capacity, aiming to ease commuters’ burdens.

Premier Chou said that, as a key Taiwanese port, Keelung’s inclusion in the capital‑region golden belt not only preserves its traditional culture but also aims to attract high‑tech industries for industrial upgrading. Urban renewal, reconstruction of aging infrastructure, and a BOT project on the former Wei‑hai military camp all seek to inject private‑sector vitality. These development plans require close cooperation between central and local authorities to move forward smoothly.

Regarding the first tender for the Wudu‑to‑Xizhi Highway 1 widening that did not yield a winner, Premier Chou specifically encouraged the Highway Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation to keep pushing forward and urged qualified firms to actively submit bids. He expressed hope that, with the combined efforts of central and local governments and local representatives, the critical project can break ground soon and provide the capital‑region public with higher‑quality, more convenient transportation services.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉融資恐殺出引爆補跌壓力 台股走勢可能有2種情境
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Wind Vane: Margin Buying Threatens to Trigger Sell‑off Pressure, Two Possible Scenarios for Market Trend
paras: 美股半導體上周五慘遭血洗，不僅費半指數崩跌超過7%，台積電ADR也重挫近6%，創8月以來新低，11月台股開局瀰漫肅殺氣氛，台股交易員認為，補跌態勢難逃，跌破半年線位置後就看融資殺出的壓力何時止住，長線投資者等待籌碼沉澱。
台股上周跌829點，周線連3黑，10月以來跌掉2728點，光輝10月成黯淡10月，台股交易員不諱言，本周市場將遭受籌碼凌亂殺出的巨大壓力，但此為整體市場的系統性議題，個股即便繳出漂亮的財報數據，恐怕也難以己身之力力挽狂瀾，先求相對持穩。
外資上周呈現連5賣，投信則是連3買，顯示內資仍是積極逢低加碼；其中，外資單周賣1734億元，自台積電提走625億元，並賣超聯發科365億元，台達電284億元，元大台灣50達236億元，日月光投控174億元，聯電和南亞均超過130億元，臻鼎-KY、國巨*和欣興均逾100億元。
永豐投顧分析，與7月不同的是，這次融資沒有降，統計2003年以來25個指數跌超過10%的波段，大盤跌約10%後融資才開始減少、跌15%以上容易出現恐慌賣出，整段融資減幅約為指數跌幅的1.23倍，且融資的高低點都落後指數，低點中位數落後11個交易日。
觀察這次指數自高點回檔約7%，融資餘額由10月12日的6533億元高點到10月29日只降到6339億元，不能完全期待用「殺融資」來確認落底，但融資的餘額減少同樣可以做為市場籌碼浮額風向球。
進入11月後，永豐投顧認為，半年線附近位置45000點是這一波的多空分水嶺，以目前的籌碼推估兩種情境，(1)盤整守住44600點以上，融資隨盤整緩降、降幅在10%以內，等於不殺融資，(2)若跌破半年線一路下探年線，大盤跌幅將達20%，融資要砍到約4200億元才會止穩。
不過，永豐投顧也提到，目前加權指數的預估本益比由6月高點約21倍，一路降到16倍出頭，已貼近16倍是近一年最低，長線布局的報酬空間變大。
paras_en: U.S. semiconductor stocks were brutally slashed last Friday, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index plunging more than 7% and TSMC ADR tumbling nearly 6% to an August low. The ominous atmosphere carried over into the opening of the November Taiwan market, and traders believe a corrective rally is inevitable. Once the index falls below its six‑month moving average, the focus will shift to when the pressure from margin‑buying sell‑offs eases, while long‑term investors wait for capital to settle.

The Taiwan market dropped 829 points last week, marking three consecutive weekly declines and a total loss of 2,728 points since October. The once‑bright October has turned bleak, and traders admit that this week the market will face intense pressure from chaotic capital outflows. Even stocks that posted impressive earnings may struggle to reverse the tide on their own, so the priority is to maintain relative stability.

Foreign investors sold for the fifth consecutive week last week, while domestic institutional investors bought for the third straight week, showing that local capital remains active in buying on dips. Foreign investors sold NT$173.4 billion in total, including NT$62.5 billion of TSMC shares, NT$36.5 billion of MediaTek, NT$28.4 billion of Delta Electronics, NT$23.6 billion of Yuanta Taiwan 50 ETF, NT$17.4 billion of ASE Technology Holding, and over NT$13 billion each of UMC and Nan Ya Plastics, as well as more than NT$10 billion each of Zhen Ding‑KY, Yageo and Unimicron.

According to Yongfeng Investment Advisory, unlike July, margin buying this time has not declined. Looking at the 25 index declines of over 10% since 2003, margin balances only began to fall after the market dropped about 10%; a decline of more than 15% often triggers panic selling. The total reduction in margin balances is roughly 1.23 times the index’s drop, and both the peaks and troughs of margin lag the index, with troughs lagging by a median of 11 trading days.

Observing that the index has retraced about 7% from its recent high, margin balances fell from a peak of NT$653.3 billion on October 12 to NT$633.9 billion on October 29. While we cannot rely solely on a “margin kill” to confirm a bottom, the shrinking margin balance still serves as a useful gauge of market‑wide capital flow.

Entering November, Yongfeng sees the 45,000‑point level near the six‑month moving average as the watershed between bulls and bears. Based on current capital conditions, they outline two scenarios: (1) if the market consolidates above 44,600 points, margin balances will ease gradually with a decline of less than 10%, meaning no aggressive margin liquidation; (2) if the index breaks below the six‑month line and heads toward the yearly average, the market could fall up to 20%, and margin balances would need to be cut to around NT$420 billion before stabilizing.

Yongfeng also notes that the weighted index’s forward P/E ratio has fallen from a June high of about 21× to just over 16×, near a one‑year low. This lower valuation expands the potential return space for long‑term investors.

items.title: AI不只要算力更拚交付速度！FII、FIT深化合作因應客戶「昨天到貨」急單需求
items.title_en: AI Needs Not Only Compute Power but Faster Delivery! FII and FIT Deepen Cooperation to Meet Customers' “Yesterday Delivery” Urgent Orders
paras: AI需求快速擴大，客戶對供應鏈的要求已不再只是產品效能與技術規格，更進一步延伸至供應規模及交付速度。鴻海(2317-TW)透過集團垂直整合優勢，結合工業富聯(FII)(601138-CN)的AI運算系統整合能力，以及旗下鴻騰精密科技(FIT)(6088-HK)的高速互聯與關鍵零組件技術，透過技術創新與協同合作，共同因應客戶對下一世代 AI 基礎設施的需求。
FII董事長鄭弘孟與FIT董事長盧松青於2026鴻海科技日對談時指出，AI發展已進入系統競爭的新階段。盧松青表示，過去客戶關心的是產品規格能不能做出來，如今則進一步要求能否做得更多、更快，甚至希望當天下午就能交貨。鄭弘孟也幽默回應，有些客戶甚至恨不得產品「昨天就能搭火箭送到」，凸顯AI需求快速攀升下，客戶對供應鏈反應速度及交付效率的要求日益提高。
從鴻海集團角度來看，AI伺服器並非單一產品的競爭，而是涵蓋運算系統、連接技術、電力管理與散熱等多個環節。FII聚焦AI運算系統與伺服器整合，FIT則從高速互聯及關鍵零組件切入，透過各自的技術專長，加上鴻海母集團跨領域資源與垂直整合能力，可望進一步強化產品開發與系統整合的協作效率，回應客戶對AI基礎設施快速擴建及交付的需求。

隨著AI伺服器運算規模擴大，系統內部資料傳輸、機櫃供電及散熱需求同步提高，相關零組件與技術也成為AI基礎建設不可或缺的一環。FIT目前布局高密度Midplane連接器及CHIPLINK 448G，支援伺服器內部大量資料高速傳輸；光通訊方面則涵蓋800G、1.6T及CPO技術，並發展ELSFP外置光源方案。在電力與散熱方面，則透過高功率供電方案、硬銅排，以及結合快速接頭、浮動式對接與防漏設計的液冷技術，協助AI資料中心提升供電及散熱效率。
除AI資料中心外，FIT也將連接與電力管理技術延伸至智慧移動領域，布局智慧電力骨幹、高壓連接器及電子化高壓安全技術，並透過精密加工能力支援高速連接器與光通訊產品發展，持續擴大在AI及智慧移動兩大應用市場的布局。
paras_en: AI demand is expanding rapidly, and customers’ supply‑chain requirements are no longer limited to product performance and technical specifications; they now extend to supply scale and delivery speed. Hon Hai (2317‑TW) leverages its group’s vertical integration advantage, combines Industrial Fulian (FII) (601138‑CN)’s AI computing system integration capability, and its subsidiary Hon Teng Precision Technology (FIT) (6088‑HK)’s high‑speed interconnect and key component technologies. Through technological innovation and collaborative cooperation, they jointly address customers’ needs for next‑generation AI infrastructure.

FII Chairman Zheng Hongmeng and FIT Chairman Lu Songqing noted during the 2026 Hon Hai Technology Day dialogue that AI development has entered a new stage of system competition. Lu said that in the past customers cared whether product specifications could be achieved; now they further demand more, faster, and even want same‑day afternoon delivery. Zheng humorously replied that some customers even wish the product could be “rocket‑shipped yesterday,” highlighting that as AI demand soars, customers’ expectations for supply‑chain responsiveness and delivery efficiency are increasingly high.

From Hon Hai Group’s perspective, AI servers are not a competition of a single product but encompass computing systems, connectivity technology, power management and cooling across multiple links. FII focuses on AI computing systems and server integration, while FIT approaches from high‑speed interconnects and key components. By combining their technical expertise with Hon Hai’s cross‑domain resources and vertical integration capability, they aim to further strengthen product development and system integration collaboration efficiency, meeting customers’ needs for rapid AI infrastructure expansion and delivery.

As AI server computing scales grow, internal data transmission, rack power supply and cooling demands rise in tandem, making related components and technologies indispensable to AI infrastructure. FIT is currently deploying high‑density midplane connectors and CHIPLINK 448G to support massive high‑speed data transfer within servers; in optical communications it covers 800G, 1.6T and CPO technologies, and is developing an ELSFP external light source solution. For power and cooling, it offers high‑power supply schemes, hard‑copper busbars, and liquid‑cooling technology that combines quick‑connect fittings, floating docking and leak‑proof designs to boost power and thermal efficiency in AI data centers.

Beyond AI data centers, FIT is extending its connectivity and power‑management technologies to the smart mobility sector, positioning smart power backbones, high‑voltage connectors and electronic high‑voltage safety technologies, and using its precision machining capabilities to support the development of high‑speed connectors and optical communication products, continuously expanding its footprint in both AI and smart mobility markets.

items.title: 《新聞裡的產業課》宏全(9939-TW)成本上漲是助力還是壓力？拆解原物料、折舊與稼動率
items.title_en: Industry Lessons in the News: Hongquan (9939-TW) Cost Increases – Help or Pressure? Breaking Down Raw Materials, Depreciation, and Utilization Rate
paras: 2026年11月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 原料價格大漲，對製造業來說就一定是利空嗎？其實不一定。如果公司能將增加的成本轉嫁給客戶，對獲利的直接影響可能有限。真正值得注意的是，當漲價沿著供應鏈一路傳到消費者手上，會不會影響終端銷量，最後反而拖累工廠稼動率。
台灣飲料包材大廠宏全(9939-TW)，就是一個值得研究的案例。
根據韓國最大PET飲料包裝製造商、同時經營無菌充填業務的三養包裝（Samyang Packaging）揭露的ICIS報價，2026年上半年PET瓶片平均價格達每噸184.4萬韓元，較2025年全年均價上漲約35%。主要受到中東衝突推升油價，以及中國調整出口退稅政策影響，帶動PET原料價格快速走高。
PET是飲料塑膠瓶的主要原料，聚酯粒約占宏全總成本55%至60%。不過，宏全採成本加成定價，可依合約條件每2至6個月調整售價，原料漲價通常約遞延一季就能逐步轉嫁給客戶。
但成本能夠轉嫁，不代表毛利率就不會下降。
舉例來說，假設一個瓶子原本賣10元、成本7元，毛利3元，毛利率30%。原料成本增加1元後，售價也提高1元，毛利仍是3元，但毛利率卻降至27.3%。也就是說，即使保住了每個瓶子的毛利金額，毛利率仍可能因為售價與成本同步增加而受到稀釋。
然而，宏全今年第二季毛利率反而提高至27.41%，較去年同期增加5.1個百分點，主要原因在於工廠稼動率提高，以及產品組合改善。
原料成本可以透過調價逐步轉嫁，但設備折舊、部分人力等固定成本，不會因為出貨減少就立即下降。因此，當出貨量增加，同樣的固定成本可以分攤到更多產品上，每個瓶子的平均生產成本就會降低。
今年高溫帶動宏全台灣出貨量成長7%至9%、東南亞成長25%至30%，加上中國高毛利客戶比重提高，使固定成本分攤與產品組合改善帶來的效益，足以抵銷部分原料漲價的不利影響，毛利率因此不降反升。
不過，這也帶出另一個問題：宏全可以將PET成本轉嫁給飲料品牌，但飲料品牌若再將成本轉嫁給消費者，會不會因為價格上漲，反而讓飲料銷量減少？
日本最大可口可樂瓶裝商可口可樂瓶裝日本控股(2579-JP)就面臨這樣的考驗。公司表示，中東衝突使今年成本增加約20億至40億日圓，第三季PET瓶等包材成本增加約25億日圓。公司9月再度漲價，主要品項每瓶提高4至5日圓，但前三季銷量年減1%，10月預估再年減1%至3%。
不過，日本的情況不能代表全球。可口可樂總公司The Coca-Cola Company(KO-US)第三季全球銷量反而年增5%，有機營收成長7%，其中亞太地區銷量成長6%，中國與東協多個市場也維持成長。日本銷量下滑還受到天候不佳與消費者支出謹慎影響，不能完全歸因於漲價。
但可口可樂全球銷量仍在成長，不代表漲價沒有帶來壓力。公司管理層在法說會上指出，消費者越來越重視價格是否負擔得起，因此必須調整產品與包裝策略，才能維持購買意願。例如在越南推廣價格較容易負擔的單人份包裝，目前已進入超過40萬個銷售據點，且回購率高。
這說明飲料品牌並非單純將成本轉嫁給消費者就能維持銷量，還需要透過包裝規格、產品組合與價格策略，因應消費者購買行為的改變。
對宏全而言，這才是接下來需要追蹤的變化。尤其公司2025年（去年）資本支出創新高後，新產能正在陸續投入，設備折舊等固定成本也會增加。原料漲價可以透過調價逐步轉嫁，但新增產能的固定成本，最終仍需要足夠的出貨量來分攤。
如果飲料品牌調整策略後仍能維持銷量，宏全就有機會持續取得包材訂單，提高新產能稼動率；反過來，如果終端需求轉弱，造成工廠出貨量減少，即使PET成本已經成功轉嫁，毛利率仍可能承受壓力。
因此，研究原料漲價對製造業的影響，不能只看成本增加多少，更要追蹤價格沿著供應鏈傳導後，終端銷量能否維持。成本轉嫁決定公司能否保住每單位產品的毛利金額，而出貨量則影響工廠能否有效分攤固定成本。對正在擴產的宏全而言，後者尤其值得注意。

paras_en: November 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – A surge in raw material prices is not necessarily bad news for manufacturers. If a company can pass the higher costs on to customers, the direct impact on profit may be limited. What really matters is whether price hikes that travel down the supply chain to consumers will affect end‑demand and ultimately drag down factory utilization.
Taiwan’s major beverage packaging producer Hongquan (9939‑TW) is a case worth studying.

According to ICIS pricing disclosed by Samyang Packaging – Korea’s largest PET beverage packaging maker that also runs aseptic filling – the average PET bottle sheet price in the first half of 2026 reached 1.844 million KRW per ton, about 35% higher than the 2025 annual average. The rise was driven mainly by Middle‑East conflicts pushing up oil prices and China’s adjustment of export rebate policies, which spurred a rapid climb in PET resin prices.

PET is the main raw material for beverage plastic bottles, accounting for roughly 55%‑60% of Hongquan’s total cost. However, Hongquan uses cost‑plus pricing and can adjust selling prices every 2‑6 months under contract terms, typically passing raw‑material cost increases to customers after about one quarter.
But the ability to pass on costs does not guarantee that gross margins will stay unchanged.

For example, if a bottle originally sells for NT$10 with a cost of NT$7, the gross profit is NT$3 or 30%. If raw‑material cost rises by NT$1 and the selling price is raised by NT$1, the gross profit remains NT$3 but the margin falls to 27.3%. In other words, even if the dollar profit per bottle is preserved, the margin can be diluted when price and cost rise together.

Nevertheless, Hongquan’s second‑quarter gross margin this year rose to 27.41%, up 5.1 percentage points from the same period last year, mainly because factory utilization improved and the product mix shifted favorably.

Raw‑material costs can be gradually passed on through price adjustments, but fixed costs such as equipment depreciation and some labor do not drop immediately when shipments fall. Therefore, when shipment volumes increase, the same fixed costs are spread over more units, lowering the average production cost per bottle.

This year, high temperatures helped Hongquan’s shipments in Taiwan grow 7%‑9% and in Southeast Asia 25%‑30%. Combined with a higher share of high‑margin Chinese customers, the benefits from fixed‑cost absorption and a better product mix were enough to offset part of the raw‑material price pressure, so the margin actually rose instead of falling.
However, this raises another question: Hongquan can pass PET costs to beverage brands, but if those brands further pass the costs to consumers, could higher prices suppress beverage sales?

Japan’s largest Coca‑Cola bottler, Coca‑Cola Bottling Japan Holdings (2579‑JP), faces this test. The company said Middle‑East conflicts added about ¥2‑4 billion in costs this year, with PET packaging costs rising roughly ¥2.5 billion in Q3. In September it raised prices, adding ¥4‑5 per bottle for major items, yet sales fell 1% year‑over‑year in the first three quarters and are projected to decline another 1%‑3% in October.

But Japan’s situation does not represent the global picture. The Coca‑Cola Company (KO‑US) reported a 5% year‑over‑year increase in global sales in Q3, with organic revenue up 7%; Asia‑Pacific sales grew 6%, and markets such as China and ASEAN continued to expand. Japan’s sales dip was also affected by poor weather and cautious consumer spending, not solely by price hikes.

Even with global sales still growing, price increases do create pressure. Management noted in the earnings call that consumers are increasingly sensitive to affordability, so product and packaging strategies must adapt to maintain purchase intent. For example, in Vietnam the company promotes lower‑priced single‑serve packs, now available at over 400,000 retail points with high repeat‑purchase rates.

This shows that beverage brands cannot simply pass costs to consumers and expect sales to hold; they must adjust packaging formats, product mixes, and pricing tactics to match changing consumer behavior.

For Hongquan, this is the key trend to monitor. After record‑high capital expenditures in 2025, new capacity is being rolled out, which will raise depreciation and other fixed costs. While raw‑material price hikes can be offset through price adjustments, the added fixed costs of new capacity will still require sufficient shipment volumes to be spread out.

If beverage brands can maintain sales after adjusting their strategies, Hongquan can continue winning packaging orders and keep its new‑capacity utilization high. Conversely, if end‑demand weakens and factory shipments fall, even a fully passed‑on PET cost could leave margins under pressure.

Therefore, studying the impact of raw‑material price hikes on manufacturers requires looking beyond the cost increase itself to whether downstream sales can be sustained after price transmission through the supply chain. Cost pass‑through determines whether a company can preserve per‑unit gross profit, while shipment volume dictates whether factories can effectively absorb fixed costs. For a scaling Hongquan, the latter is especially critical.

items.title: 美股亂流引發台股賣壓 法人仍看好中長期基本面支撐、留意個股分化趨勢
items.title_en: U.S. Market Turbulence Triggers Selling Pressure on Taiwan Stocks; Institutions Remain Bullish on Mid‑to‑Long‑Term Fundamentals and Watch for Stock‑Specific Divergence
paras: 受美股科技股震盪與財報雜音干擾，台股近期賣壓增溫，指數劇烈波動並反覆測試底部。法人指出，雖然短線市場情緒趨於保守，致使部分亮眼財報面臨獲利了結賣壓；但從中長期來看，美國雲端巨頭AI資本支出未減，台灣半導體與科技供應鏈的關鍵地位依舊穩固。在評價與高波動並存的環境下，拉回反倒提供了中長線分批布局與多元配置的良機。
針對近期盤勢，安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中表示，國際情勢、利率走勢、聯準會政策預期與AI投資疑慮等雜音持續干擾市場，導致短期投資情緒凌駕基本面，資金動能轉趨保守。即使部分企業繳出亮眼財報，仍面臨獲利了結賣壓，致使台股短線波動明顯放大。
蕭惠中指出，雖然短線市場將反覆測試底部，但台灣科技產業的基本面並未出現轉折。美國大型雲端服務業者持續擴大AI資本支出，雲端及先進運算需求維持強勁成長，且半導體與AI相關供應鏈訂單、營收動能無虞。隨著新一代伺服器逐步出貨，相關企業第四季營收可望延續成長力道，企業獲利仍是支撐台股中長期走勢的核心基石。
隨著市場進入高利率、高評價與高波動並存的環境，聯準會利率政策、美債殖利率及地緣政治對通膨的影響仍是後續主要變數。預期台股行情將由過去的全面齊漲，逐步轉向產業與個股分化，資金將更聚焦於營收及EPS成長能見度高的企業。
在產業配置方面，安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆指出，目前投資組合以金融控股為最大產業配置，藉此提升持股多元性，並掌握市場資金輪動機會；成長布局則廣泛涵蓋半導體晶圓代工、先進封裝、記憶體、IC設計、半導體設備、PCB、工業電腦及散熱等科技供應鏈，持續掌握AI與高效能運算需求成長所帶動的結構性投資機會。
paras_en: The recent sell‑off in Taiwan equities has intensified as U.S. tech stocks wobble and earnings noise creates interference, causing the index to swing wildly and repeatedly test its lows. Institutions note that while short‑term market sentiment has become cautious—leading to profit‑taking pressure on some standout earnings—the mid‑to‑long‑term outlook remains solid: U.S. cloud giants continue robust AI capital spending and Taiwan’s semiconductor and tech supply chain retains its pivotal role. In a setting of high valuations and volatility, the pullback actually offers a good chance for phased, diversified positioning over the medium to long term.

Regarding the latest market action, Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Tech Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung said that international developments, interest‑rate trends, Fed policy expectations and AI‑investment concerns continue to cloud the market, causing short‑term sentiment to outweigh fundamentals and capital flows to become more conservative. Even companies delivering impressive earnings face profit‑taking pressure, amplifying short‑term volatility in Taiwan stocks.

Hsu pointed out that although the short‑term market will keep testing the bottom, the fundamentals of Taiwan’s tech industry have not turned. Major U.S. cloud service providers are still expanding AI capital expenditures, keeping demand for cloud and high‑performance computing strong, and semiconductor and AI‑related supply‑chain orders and revenue momentum remain intact. As the next‑generation servers roll out, related firms are expected to sustain revenue growth into Q4, with corporate earnings remaining the core support for Taiwan’s mid‑to‑long‑term market trajectory.

As the market moves into an environment of high rates, high valuations and high volatility, the Fed’s rate policy, U.S. Treasury yields and geopolitical impacts on inflation remain the key variables ahead. The Taiwan market is expected to shift from a broad‑based rally to increasing sector and stock‑specific divergence, with capital focusing more on companies that show clear revenue and EPS growth visibility.

On the sector‑allocation side, Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW) manager Liao Pen‑Long said the current portfolio is weighted most heavily toward financial holding companies to boost diversification and capture fund‑rotation opportunities. The growth tilt spans semiconductor wafer foundries, advanced packaging, memory, IC design, semiconductor equipment, PCBs, industrial PCs and cooling solutions, continuously targeting structural investment opportunities driven by AI and high‑performance computing demand growth.

items.title: 金居啟動大馬建廠計畫 高階銅箔新廠落腳居林、取得3.12萬坪土地
items.title_en: Jinju Launches Malaysia Plant Project, New High-End Copper Foil Factory to Be Built in Kulim, Acquires 31,200 Ping Land
paras: 2026年挑戰賺回一個股本的銅箔廠金居(8358-TW)，積極擴充高頻、高速銅箔產能以因應市場AI產品的高速需求擴張，金居除雲林三廠2027年逐季開出新產能之外，亦規劃於馬來西亞檳城周邊設立新廠，宣布取得馬國吉打州的居林高科技園區Kulim Hi-Tech Park Phase 4A的土地使用權資產，總面積換算達3.12萬坪。
大馬的吉打州的居林高科技園區(Kulim Hi-Tech Park)區域內科技業者，包括了生產高階載板的AT&S公司及英特爾、英飛凌、富士電機。金居規劃投資馬國新廠占地達3.12萬坪，主要生產HVLP4高頻高速高階應用銅箔，整體規劃產能達年產3萬噸。
金居規劃於馬來西亞居林高科技園區設立新廠，預計分兩期建置，第一批產能將於2028年第三至第四季陸續開出，第二期則規劃於2029年下半年啟動，並以分階段擴充。金居馬來西亞新廠總投資金額初估約80億至100億元，同時，金居也擬在台灣發行可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資支應，預估其發行面額在70億元水準。

金居對在馬來西亞居林高科技園區投資興建新廠，將以HVLP4為主要生產方向規劃，搭配台灣三廠的高階銅箔產能，形成未來高階產品供應布局。而台灣三廠產能也將逐季開出；隨著AI伺服器及高速傳輸技術持續升級，對低損耗、高性能銅箔的要求同步提高，公司將透過新廠建置及既有產線產品調整，擴大高階銅箔供應能力，支應未來市場需求。
paras_en: In 2026, Jinju (8358-TW), a copper foil plant aiming to earn back one share capital, is actively expanding high‑frequency, high‑speed copper foil capacity to meet the rapid growth of AI product demand. Kedah’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park hosts technology companies such as AT&S, which produces high‑end substrates, as well as Intel, Infineon and Fuji Electric. Jinju plans to invest in a new Malaysian plant covering 31,200 ping, primarily to produce HVLP4 high‑frequency, high‑speed, high‑end application copper foil, with an overall design capacity of 30,000 tonnes per year.

Jinju intends to build the new plant in Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in two phases. The first batch of capacity is expected to come online gradually in the third to fourth quarters of 2028, while the second phase is slated to start in the second half of 2029 with staged expansions. The total investment for the Malaysian plant is initially estimated at NT$8‑10 billion, and Jinju also plans to issue convertible bonds (CB) in Taiwan to raise funds, with an anticipated issuance amount of around NT$7 billion.

Jinju’s plan for the new plant in Malaysia’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park includes serving not only CCL’s Taiwan Semiconductor (2383‑TW), which has a plant in Malaysia, but also other regional customers such as Taiwan’s Tai Yao (6274‑TW) in Thailand, Teng‑Hui‑KY (6672‑TW) and Lian‑Mao (6213‑TW).

Jinju’s investment in a new plant at Kulim Hi‑Tech Park will focus on HVLP4 production, complementing the high‑end copper foil capacity of its three Taiwanese factories to create a future supply network for premium products. As the three Taiwanese plants ramp up capacity quarter by quarter, the ongoing upgrades in AI servers and high‑speed transmission technologies are driving higher demand for low‑loss, high‑performance copper foil. The company will expand its high‑end copper foil supply capability through the new plant and adjustments to existing lines to meet future market needs.

items.title_en: AI Computing Power Hits the Transmission Ceiling! PCB and CCL Materials Embrace a "Hybrid Revolution", Unveiling the Next Trillion‑Dollar Upgrade Opportunity
paras: AI 算力狂飆使傳輸極限提早報到，電路板產業正全面跨入系統級半導體化整合，從 M10 基材、石英布到玻璃核心載板，材料與工藝走向「混合化革新」，高階產能稀缺確立長線多頭，下一波千億升級商機已蓄勢待發。

paras_en: The surge in AI computing power is pushing transmission limits ahead of schedule, and the circuit board industry is fully moving toward system‑level semiconductor integration. From M10 substrates and quartz fabrics to glass‑core substrates, materials and processes are shifting toward "hybrid innovation," making high‑end capacity scarce and establishing a long‑term bullish outlook, with the next trillion‑dollar upgrade opportunity poised to emerge.
M10‑grade substrates debut, quartz fabric and RCC solutions vie for market share.

Under the material upgrade framework, high‑frequency, high‑speed CCL officially enters the new M10 era. To achieve extreme low loss and high reliability, leading manufacturers are adopting solutions such as quartz glass fabric (Q‑Glass), PTFE resin formulations, and non‑glass‑fiber back‑bonded copper foils (RCC/ZRCC) to lower Dk/Df and boost dielectric strength. Meanwhile, server motherboards, constrained by line‑density and layer‑count miniaturization, are accelerating the adoption of high‑layer count (HLC) boards combined with high‑density interconnect (HDI) hybrid designs, even extending to semi‑additive (mSAP) type substrate processes, breaking the physical transmission limits of traditional circuit boards.
Core substrate architecture upgrades, high‑end materials in tight demand, testing process yields.

As advanced‑package chip sizes continue to expand, IC substrate structures face severe rigidity and warp‑control challenges, driving multilayer core (MLC), glass‑core, and ceramic substrates into the spotlight. Premium raw materials such as high‑grade glass fiber fabrics, ultra‑low‑profile copper foils (HVLP4/5), and wear‑resistant precision drill bits are under constant supply pressure, giving material suppliers with cost‑pass‑through ability greater bargaining power. At the same time, board makers are heavily tested on yield control for thick‑board lamination and precise alignment, highlighting the scarce value of high‑end capacity.

items.title: Alliant拚半年新增1GW資料中心用電合約，資本支出仍有上調空間
items.title_en: Alliant Aims to Secure 1GW of New Data Center Power Contracts in Six Months, Capital Expenditure Still Has Upside
paras: 2026年11月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國電力公司Alliant Energy(LNT-US)於法說會表示，預期未來六個月可再取得約1GW大型用電客戶合約，為後續電力建設帶來新增投資需求。目前旗下公用事業已簽約的資料中心用電需求達3.4GW，公司並將2027至2030年四年資本支出計畫提高至159億美元（約新台幣5,164億元），較前一版四年計畫增加19%。
新增合約與實際用電之間仍有時間差。公司預估，下一批約1GW需求將在2029至2030年開始逐步增加，用來支應需求的燃氣發電設施，預計約在2030至2031年投入。因此，相關投資一部分會落在目前四年計畫內，另一部分則延續至2031年以後。
財務長Robert Durian表示，每增加1GW用電需求，約需新增20億至30億美元（約新台幣650億至974億元）資本支出，主要投入滿足客戶供電容量需求的設備。公司會配合客戶用電增加的時程安排發電設施，讓建設完成後的供電與現金流同步銜接。
Alliant也提高新專案納入投資計畫的門檻。除了簽署供電合約，還須確認土地、輸電、發電及地方許可等條件。這使得目前的資本支出計畫尚未包含所有洽談中的機會，後續仍將隨專案進度調整。

paras_en: November 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – U.S. utility Alliant Energy (LNT-US) said at its earnings call that it expects to win roughly 1 GW of large‑scale power contracts for data centers over the next six months, creating new investment demand for future power construction. The utility’s existing data‑center power contracts already total 3.4 GW, and the company has raised its 2027‑2030 four‑year capital‑expenditure plan to $15.9 billion (about NT$5,164 billion), a 19% increase over the previous plan.

There is a lag between signing contracts and actual power consumption. Alliant estimates that the next batch of about 1 GW of demand will start to ramp up gradually in 2029‑2030, and the gas‑fired generation facilities needed to meet that demand are expected to come online around 2030‑2031. Consequently, part of the related investment will fall within the current four‑year plan, while the remainder will extend beyond 2031.

Chief Financial Officer Robert Durian said that each additional 1 GW of power demand requires roughly $2‑3 billion (about NT$65‑97.4 billion) of capital spending, mainly for equipment to satisfy the customers’ supply‑capacity needs. The company will align the timing of new generation facilities with customers’ consumption schedules so that power delivery and cash flow are synchronized once construction is completed.

Alliant also raised the threshold for new projects to be included in its investment plan. In addition to signing power‑supply agreements, projects must now meet land, transmission, generation and local‑permit requirements. This means the current capital‑expenditure plan does not yet cover all opportunities under negotiation and will be adjusted as projects progress.
